name: Barbell Z Press
steps: Sit directly on the floor inside a rack with your legs straight out in a comfortable V and your torso completely upright.
Grip the barbell just outside shoulder width, unrack it onto your front shoulders, and brace your core firmly.
Press the bar straight overhead while shifting your head back briefly to clear your chin, finishing stacked over your shoulders.
Lower the bar under strict control back to your front shoulders without leaning backward.
tips: Keep your legs pressed firmly into the floor and your rib cage stacked over your pelvis throughout each press.
Avoid rocking backward or rounding your lower back to force the bar upward.
